_about: Care standards (OPENCARE-99, OPENCARE-115, OPENCARE-116). Each step becomes a K item the draft must cover. {name} is the resident. Wording and bands from the tickets; awaiting clinical sign-off (Linda, Stobhill). Edit a copy and point CAREPLAN_AI_CARE_STANDARDS_FILE at it to change the wording without a release.

bands.name: Low risk
steps: Weigh {name} monthly on the same scales.
Rescreen MUST monthly, or sooner if {name}'s weight drops.

bands.name: Medium risk
steps: Weigh {name} weekly on the same scales.
Record everything {name} eats and drinks on the Food and Fluid charts.
Rescreen MUST monthly, or sooner if {name}'s weight drops.
Tell the nurse or GP, and follow up any dietitian referral, if {name}'s weight keeps falling or {name} eats less than half of each meal for 3 days.

bands.name: High risk
steps: Refer {name} to the dietitian, or follow up the referral, and follow the advice given.
Weigh {name} weekly on the same scales.
Record everything {name} eats and drinks on the Food and Fluid charts.
Rescreen MUST monthly, or sooner if {name}'s weight drops.
Tell the nurse or GP if {name}'s weight keeps falling or {name} eats less than half of each meal for 3 days.

bands.name: At risk
steps: Check {name}'s skin every day, including the sacrum, heels, hips and elbows, and the ears if {name} is on oxygen.
Help {name} change position at least every 4 hours, day and night, including when sitting in a chair.
Keep {name}'s skin clean and dry.
Encourage {name} to eat and drink well.

bands.name: High risk
steps: Check {name}'s skin every day, including the sacrum, heels, hips and elbows, and the ears if {name} is on oxygen.
Help {name} change position every 2 to 3 hours, day and night, including when sitting in a chair, and record each change.
Use a pressure-relieving mattress on {name}'s bed and a pressure-relieving cushion on {name}'s chair.
Keep {name}'s skin clean and dry.
Encourage {name} to eat and drink well.

bands.name: Very high risk
steps: Check {name}'s skin every day, including the sacrum, heels, hips and elbows, and the ears if {name} is on oxygen.
Help {name} change position every 2 hours, day and night, including when sitting in a chair, and record each change.
Use a specialist pressure-relieving mattress on {name}'s bed and a pressure-relieving cushion on {name}'s chair.
Refer {name} to the tissue viability nurse, or follow up the referral, and follow the advice given.
Keep {name}'s skin clean and dry.
Encourage {name} to eat and drink well.

choking.label: Choking care standard - {band}

modified.name: {diet}
steps: Sit {name} fully upright for every meal, snack and drink.
Supervise {name} while eating and drinking.
Stop if {name} coughs or {name}'s voice sounds wet while eating or drinking, and tell the nurse.
Do not give {name} food or drink while drowsy.

low.name: Low risk
steps: Remind {name} to eat slowly and take small mouthfuls.
Sit {name} upright for meals.

choking.not_recorded: Diet level not recorded: no IDDSI diet or fluid level was found in {name}'s records, so Open Care Buddy did not add one. Check the latest SLT advice.

fluid.label: Fluid care standard
fluid.step: Offer {name} a drink every 1-2 hours while awake to reach {target} a day, and record each drink on the {chart}.

fever.step: Watch {name}'s temperature and chest, and tell the nurse if {name} has a temperature of {threshold} °C or more, a chesty cough, or new or sudden confusion.

postural_drop.step: Help {name} sit for a moment before standing, and check {name}'s lying and standing blood pressure.
